prompt: I'm a PhD researcher and I have a set of interview transcript files that were exported from our audio transcription platform. Please process all the raw interview transcript files so they are ready for import. The files should be updated in place (do not move them or create copies). Make sure every file is handled, including any that might have been saved with unusual character encodings.
